The recommended model has a real digest, source, license, size, compatibility metadata, resilient download, and deletion controls

Every supported platform artifact satisfies its signing and notarization requirements on a clean machine

The v-tag release job distributes only platforms included in the supported beta matrix; Android and iOS simulator outputs remain excluded or separately gated
A release-SHA-bound adversarial evaluation pack proves the public safety thresholds and discloses denominators, failures, and limitations
The release candidate completes the invited-tester bake and all release-blocking defects are closed or explicitly mitigated

approvedStatements.exact: SkyTwin is preparing a desktop-first `v0.7.0-beta`. It is **not release-ready**:
SkyTwin keeps its persistent application database on the device where you install it.
OAuth-token storage is mixed and depends on vault state, while your twin profile, preferences, memory, receipts, and search indexes remain unencrypted by SkyTwin.
Checking which maintained local model fits this computer…
later capability inference may send selected metadata to that provider.
Your twin's persistent memory is stored in SkyTwin's configured database;
No model provider configured. Built-in rules remain available; on-device model reasoning requires a compatible local runtime and model.
Stored without app-level encryption in SkyTwin's configured database
keeps the reasoning prompt on this device
Published installers predate the guarded account-free sample now in source.
signed-update installation is not yet verified

evidence.why: Repository license text
Root release metadata names Apache-2.0

verification.expected: Exit 0 and LICENSE remains the Apache 2.0 text

claims.statement: The packaged desktop process stores its CockroachDB files under the OS user-data directory and binds the database listener to loopback by default.
claims.scope: SkyTwin's persistent application database in the desktop topology; this does not mean connectors or configured providers avoid network requests, and it does not assert application-level encryption.
claims.limitation: Source evidence exists, but the final tagged artifact still needs clean-machine filesystem and listener verification on each supported platform.

evidence.why: Defines userData/crdb-data and 127.0.0.1 listener defaults

verification.expected: Desktop Cockroach manager path, lifecycle, and listener tests pass

claims.statement: OAuth tokens are encrypted at rest by default in the shipping app.
claims.scope: New and existing Google/Microsoft OAuth token rows across API and worker processes.
claims.limitation: Storage depends on vault state: without an initialized vault, callbacks retain plaintext tokens; an unlocked matching API vault encrypts new grants and can migrate complete legacy pairs on authorized use; a locked or stale initialized vault refuses new writes instead of downgrading. Worker key delivery is still unavailable, so this blanket claim must not appear in release copy.

evidence.why: The production repository supports ciphertext plus legacy plaintext columns, with encryption selected by the API vault state
Documents and implements an empty worker-local key cache without cross-process handoff

verification.expected: Vault primitive and lazy-migration tests pass; this does not upgrade the prohibited release claim
The release reviewer confirms the active grant path and updates this state only after encrypted writes are proven

claims.statement: Twin profiles, learned preferences, memory text, full-text indexes, and embeddings are encrypted at rest by SkyTwin.
claims.scope: The production database columns and searchable derivatives used by the default gbrain memory backend.
claims.limitation: Encryption columns/helpers exist, but the production preference key provider is unset and the profile/memory write paths remain plaintext; searchable derivatives also require an explicit design boundary.

evidence.why: Preference encryption is conditional on a provider that production does not set
Default memory repository writes searchable plaintext and vectors

verification.expected: No production composition-root caller exists until the encryption work changes this claim
Conditional crypto tests pass; production activation remains a separate stop-ship requirement

claims.statement: SkyTwin can perform text inference on-device through llama.cpp when a compatible binary and GGUF model are present.
claims.scope: Persisted on-device mode for decision-event text inference: an available embedded backend or a canonical loopback Ollama endpoint. It does not cover model acquisition, connectors, updates, or other application network activity.
claims.limitation: Embedded inference requires its binary and compatible model; Ollama requires a supported local runtime, a local-source-qualified model, loopback endpoint, no redirects, and runtime locality verification. Tagged packaged-machine evidence is still absent, so this is not a whole-app offline claim.

evidence.why: Composes the persisted mode and admits embedded or locality-verified loopback Ollama only when their prerequisites pass

verification.expected: Availability gates and local/cloud ordering tests pass
Missing binary/model cases fail to the unavailable port

claims.statement: SkyTwin offers attestation-verified confidential inference with independently verifiable receipts.
claims.scope: Remote inference requests, endpoint/model identity, attestation freshness, request/response binding, persisted receipts, and fail-closed fallback behavior.
claims.limitation: Typed signed receipts, persistence, integrity verification, and atomic decision-event capture exist. Verified-private mode remains unavailable because no production attestation-backed provider adapter, pinned provider and recorder trust roots, provider-specific verification policy, or product receipt export path is wired.

evidence.why: Exports provider modes and receipt emission primitives, while verified-private client construction remains unavailable
Exports the signed inference-receipt contract and verifier used by the decision-event capture path

verification.expected: Receipt primitives are present, while no production verified-private provider or attestation policy is admitted

claims.statement: SkyTwin is local-first, not network-free: connected services, hosted providers, configured execution adapters, paired federation peers, model/runtime downloads, release checks, and opt-in crash reporting may create outbound requests.
claims.scope: Desktop and its managed API/web/worker processes; bring-your-own-provider Ollama can be remote, execution adapters can receive action descriptions and parameters, and federation can exchange encrypted state deltas with configured peers. Only on-device Ollama is constrained to verified loopback/local execution. Exact destinations depend on enabled features and operator configuration.
claims.limitation: A release artifact still needs a measured network inventory and offline test tied to its SHA; local-first must never be shortened to no-cloud or no-network.

evidence.why: Public disclosure names connector, hosted-provider, execution-adapter, federation, and diagnostic boundaries
Provider factory permits hosted providers only when configured and defines local-first ordering
Configured HTTP execution sends action descriptions, parameters, and steps to the adapter endpoint
Configured IronClaw HTTP calls and credential synchronization cross the process boundary
Federation sync encrypts state deltas and posts them to configured peer endpoints

verification.expected: Absolute no-network/no-egress phrases are absent from release-facing surfaces
